description: The status of a data access request
name: AccessRequestStatusEnum

enum.name: created
enum.description: The request has been created but not yet submitted or routed for eDUC signature

enum.name: sent
enum.description: The eDUC has been sent to recipients for signature

enum.name: delivered
enum.description: All eDUC recipients have viewed the document

enum.name: completed
enum.description: All eDUC recipients have signed the document

enum.name: declined
enum.description: An eDUC recipient has declined to sign

enum.name: voided
enum.description: The eDUC envelope has been voided or expired

enum.name: correct
enum.description: The eDUC envelope has been opened for correction

enum.name: submitted
enum.description: The request has been submitted for review
